prs.title: Fix off-by-one in pager
prs.diff:
--- a/pager.c
+++ b/pager.c
@@ -41 +41 @@
-  for (i = 0; i <= n; i++)
+  for (i = 0; i < n; i++)
prs.comment: The loop bound was one too high; the fix is right and covered by the new test.

prs.title: Remove input validation
prs.comment: This removes the only check on the request; an invalid request now reaches the parser.

prs.title: Rewrite the scheduler
prs.diff:
--- a/sched.c
+++ b/sched.c
@@ -1,300 +1,420 @@
(a rewrite of the scheduler, 420 lines)
prs.comment: A large rewrite with tests for each queue; no defect found, but the size deserves a second reader.
